desc: Correct the \(p=2\) implementation by replacing zeros with \(1\) and computing \(B^2\).
Validate the \(p=3\) exceptional non-loop contributions and global \((-1)^K\) factor.
Verify matrix exponentiation and modular arithmetic for \(C^p\).
